exposure: histological stage and grade of chorioamnionitis
outcome: procalcitonin levels in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 145 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies and their neonates at a tertiary center between September 2010 and March 2013
finding: Procalcitonin levels in umbilical cord blood were correlated with the severity of chorioamnionitis and associated with neonatal outcomes such as neonatal sepsis, neonatal death, and severe IVH.
